name: one_pole_a328_round
description: one-pole IIR y' = y + a*(x - y), alpha = 328/32768, rounding update, vs single_pole_iir_filter_ff

expect.rationale: The update a*(x - y) >> 15 stops once it rounds to 0: dead band 1/(2*alpha) = 50.0 LSB, plus 1 LSB output quantization. SNR bound is the measured value minus 1 dB (regression guard).
